style: Original editorial comic illustration for a software engineering presentation. Premium clean 3D-meets-ink rendering, rounded geometric objects, deliberate dark purple outlines, dimensional soft shading, white background with a very subtle pale lavender grounding shadow. Restrained palette: vivid purple #512BD4, lilac #B9AAEE, pale lavender #EEEAFB, deep purple ink #190649, white. Friendly original small helper robot with a squared rounded head, two small circular eyes and compact box-shaped body, no antenna and no resemblance to any branded mascot. All subjects fully inside the frame with at least 12 percent white breathing room on every edge. Crisp silhouette, one strong focal story, composition understandable at thumbnail size, no busy scenery. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, code, logos, watermarks, user interfaces, screenshots, currency symbols, or product marks. This is conceptual artwork, not evidence of a real product or run. Do not create a slide or add a title.

assets.purpose: Show a skill as a portable package with instructions, resources and a repeatable workflow
assets.prompt: A compact friendly purple helper robot carefully places one blank lavender recipe card into an open white-and-purple modular toolbox. Inside the toolbox are a small blank book, three neat geometric blocks and a small simple wrench. The card has only three abstract horizontal recessed grooves, no writing. The robot and open toolbox form one clear centered group. Three-quarter view, soft studio light from upper left, generous white margins. The idea is reusable know-how packaged as a practical tool.
assets.altText: Conceptual illustration of a robot placing a blank guidance card into a reusable toolkit

assets.purpose: Make the transition from scattered explanations to explicit reusable guidance tangible
assets.prompt: On the left, three loose blank lavender note cards and two empty speech bubbles float in a loose cluster. In the center, a small friendly purple helper robot gathers them carefully. On the right, a neat open white ring binder holds three clean blank cards with simple geometric color tabs. The three groups feel connected by their poses and composition, no arrows or text. Keep the entire scene comfortably inside frame. The idea is scattered team knowledge becoming a clearly organized reusable guide, not magic.
assets.altText: Conceptual illustration of scattered notes becoming an organized reusable guide

assets.purpose: Depict a narrow library replacement while preserving the surrounding behavior
assets.prompt: A small friendly purple helper robot performs a precise replacement of one lilac cube module in a compact white mechanical assembly on a clean tabletop. The assembly has three simple interlocking geometric parts. The robot holds the replacement cube in one hand while the original matching cube rests beside the assembly. Surrounding parts remain neatly intact. No sparks, damage, broken parts, symbols or checkmarks. Close three-quarter composition, fully framed. The story is a careful compatible component swap rather than rebuilding everything.
assets.altText: Conceptual illustration of a careful component swap that preserves the surrounding system

assets.purpose: Illustrate checking evidence impartially without claiming a baseline or guided winner
assets.prompt: A small friendly purple helper robot holds a large simple magnifying glass over two equally sized neat stacks of blank white cards side by side. Each stack has the same abstract lilac geometric shapes. Both stacks are treated equally and look neutral. The magnifier enlarges a single geometric detail, no writing, ticks, crosses, scoreboards, graphs or winner cues. Calm attentive pose. A small lavender ruler with no marks lies nearby. Clean centered composition, soft studio light, generous white margins. The story is comparing observable details rather than impressions.
assets.altText: Conceptual illustration of examining two neutral evidence stacks without declaring a winner
